notes: «فِي كِتَابِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْكُلَيْنِيِّ» cites a book by its author: the author is written as the text names him, but whether a cited author is a link is for the ruling (rule 11)
«أخويه محمد وأحمد» — co-transmitters in one level; «أبيهما» is a bare relation (rule 7)
Buraid tells the story; the Imam answers «ذاك له»: the Imam is the last link (rule 6, owner ruling 5)
